name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v5.90: serve the OTA APK from the SAME origin the manifest request arrived on. v5.88 stored the APK URL against APP_URL (admin.agvending.is), a custom domain whose Lets Encrypt cert chains through a root that old kiosk trust stores lack, so the download failed with the same unacceptable-certificate error as GitHub while the API origin (*.up.railway.app) was trusted. The release now stores a RELATIVE apk path and the app-update manifest resolves it to an absolute URL on the request origin (via x-forwarded-host / host), so the machine always downloads from the exact host it just polled and the two can never drift. Cumulative over v5.89.
